title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Based Therapy for Cerebellar Ataxia: From Bench to Bedside
journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Suk K 等（韓國慶北大學）
tag: MSC 治療共濟失調 · 系統性回顧
note: → 直接對應本社機制的獨立回顧（文獻期間 2000–2026）：hMSC 移植在 LPS 誘發、Ara-C 誘發與 SCA2 轉基因模型皆改善運動功能、保留浦金氏細胞完整性並抑制神經發炎；關鍵觀察是共濟失調病人自體 MSC 的抗發炎分泌體能力明顯低於健康捐贈者，為異體（allogeneic）策略提供理由；SCA2 模型在症狀出現後給藥仍見療效。作者結論支持推進安慰劑對照隨機試驗。

en.tag: MSC therapy for ataxia · systematic review
en.journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Suk K et al. (Kyungpook National University, Korea)
en.note: → An independent review that maps directly onto Steminent's mechanism (literature 2000–2026): hMSC transplantation improved motor function, preserved Purkinje cell integrity and attenuated neuroinflammation across LPS-induced, Ara-C-induced and SCA2 transgenic models. A key observation is that MSCs from ataxia patients show markedly lower anti-inflammatory secretome capacity than healthy-donor MSCs, which justifies an allogeneic strategy; efficacy in the SCA2 model was maintained even when dosing began after symptom onset. The authors conclude that placebo-controlled randomised trials are warranted.

title: N140 Latency as a Novel Biomarker for the Evaluation of Somatosensory Dysfunction in Patients with Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 2
journal: Cerebellum · Gutiérrez J 等（古巴神經學與神經外科研究所）
tag: SCA2 生物標記 · 電生理
note: → 古巴 SCA2 世代（28 名病人 vs 34 名年齡配對對照）發現長潛時體感覺誘發電位 N140 潛時延長，且 N140 與 N20 潛時皆與 SARA 分數正相關；作者主張 N140 可作為 N20 之外的補充指標，反映視丘－皮質與小腦－皮質連結缺損。與試驗生物標記／次要終點選擇相關。

en.journal: Cerebellum · Gutiérrez J et al. (Cuban Institute of Neurology and Neurosurgery)
en.note: → In a Cuban SCA2 cohort (28 patients vs 34 age-matched controls), long-latency somatosensory evoked potential N140 latency was prolonged, and both N140 and N20 latencies correlated positively with SARA scores. The authors argue N140 complements N20 and reflects impaired thalamo-cortical and cerebello-cortical connectivity — relevant to biomarker and secondary-endpoint selection in trials.

title: Muscle MRI as an Imaging Biomarker of Muscle Damage in Patients With Spinal and Bulbar Muscular Atrophy
journal: Neurology · Grunseich C 等（NIH／名古屋大學／UCL／Nido Biosciences）
tag: SBMA 影像生物標記（polyQ 鄰域）
note: → 非介入縱貫研究，全身 Dixon MRI 以 AMRA Researcher 量測雙側 19 組肌肉的瘦肌肉體積、肌肉脂肪分率與脂肪浸潤，基線起每 6 個月追蹤至 18 個月，並與 SBMAFRS、2 分鐘步行測試比對靈敏度。此即 Nido Biosciences 於 NIDO-361 Ph2 採用之主要終點的方法學來源。

en.journal: Neurology · Grunseich C et al. (NIH / Nagoya University / UCL / Nido Biosciences)
en.note: → A non-interventional longitudinal study using whole-body Dixon MRI analysed with AMRA Researcher to quantify lean muscle volume, muscle fat fraction and fat infiltration across 19 bilateral muscle groups, assessed at baseline and every 6 months for up to 18 months, and correlated with SBMAFRS and the 2-minute walk test. This is the methodological source of the primary endpoint Nido Biosciences used in the NIDO-361 Ph2.

title: Beyond the brain: Polyglutamine disease pathology outside the nervous system
journal: Neurobiol Dis · Rausch JP 等（Wayne State University）
tag: polyQ 多系統病理 · 回顧
note: → 主張 polyQ 疾病（亨丁頓舞蹈症、SBMA、DRPLA 與六種 SCA）應視為具器官選擇性的全身性蛋白錯誤折疊症候群：臨床、影像、生化與屍檢資料顯示周邊器官異常常早於或伴隨神經症狀出現，並影響失能與死亡率。作者建議未來試驗設計納入縱貫、多系統表現型評估。

en.journal: Neurobiol Dis · Rausch JP et al. (Wayne State University)
en.note: → Argues that polyglutamine diseases (Huntington's disease, SBMA, DRPLA and six spinocerebellar ataxias) should be viewed as systemic protein-misfolding syndromes with organ-selective vulnerability: clinical, imaging, biochemical and post-mortem data show peripheral abnormalities that often precede or accompany neurological symptoms and contribute to disability and mortality. The authors call for longitudinal, multisystem phenotyping in future trial design.

en.journal: Clin Case Rep · Lim ECN et al.
en.note: → A diagnostic-pitfall case of Machado-Joseph disease (SCA3) presenting as a peripheral neuropathy (Charcot-Marie-Tooth-like); SCA3 phenotype-recognition and differential-diagnosis intelligence.

en.journal: J Neurol · Cros L et al.

journal: Genes Dev · Hernandez-Quijada K 等

en.journal: Genes Dev · Hernandez-Quijada K et al.
en.note: → Reviews why broadly expressed disease genes damage only specific brain regions: ATXN1 and ATXN1L each prefer CIC-L or CIC-S, creating tissue-dependent vulnerability — a companion to the Capicua isoform work published alongside it.

title: Functional divergence of Capicua isoforms explains differential tissue vulnerability in neurological disease
journal: Genes Dev · Lee H 等
note: → 闡明 ATXN1（SCA1 致病蛋白）交互作用夥伴 Capicua 的兩種異構物 CIC-L／CIC-S 功能分化：各偏好結合不同 ATXN1 家族成員，可解釋 SCA1 為何選擇性侵犯小腦——屬 SCA1 致病機制與組織脆弱性基礎研究。

en.journal: Genes Dev · Lee H et al.
en.note: → Shows how the two isoforms of Capicua (CIC-L / CIC-S), an interaction partner of ATXN1 (the SCA1 disease protein), diverge functionally — each preferring different ATXN1-family members, which helps explain why SCA1 selectively strikes the cerebellum. Basic research on SCA1 pathogenesis and tissue vulnerability.
